conflict_resolutions.NO_ORDER_CITED_IN_CURRENT_LAW: The current-law lead is the 5 U.S.C. 601 note, a status-line mention of EO 13422 as an amending order of EO 12866. A mention of an amending order is a weak lead, not a legal basis that keeps EO 13422 operating, and EO 13497 section 1 revoked EO 13422 by number in 2009. The no status stands.
conflict_resolutions.WHOLE_END_DATE_MISSING_OR_DISPUTED: The single whole-order end is EO 13497, signed 2009-01-30, whose section 1 revokes EO 13422 by number and states no later effective date; the held Federal Register text gives the exact date, so the missing-date flag does not leave a gap. Later orders that touch EO 12866 are not ends of this order.

research_rationale:
EO 13422 of January 18, 2007 consists of amendments to sections of Executive Order 12866, which remained in force as a separate order. Section 1 of EO 13497 of January 30, 2009 revokes EO 13422 and EO 13258 by number: "Executive Order 13258 of February 26, 2002, and Executive Order 
13422 of January 18, 2007, concerning regulatory planning and review, which 
amended Executive Order 12866 of September 30, 1993, are revoked." The held corpus contains no earlier revocation, supersession or amendment of EO 13422, and the order contains no sunset or report date. The dossier's whole-end conflict is resolved by identifying EO 13497, dated January 30, 2009, as the single actor of the first end; later orders that touch EO 12866 (the dossier lists EO 13777 and EO 14215) amend or concern that separate order and are not ends of EO 13422. A by-number search of the held order texts for EO 13422 finds EO 13497 and EO 14219 (Federal Register and American Presidency Project copies of each) and this order's own text. EO 14219 of February 19, 2025, section 6 (Definitions), says that its term for a regulation also includes any guidance document as defined in EO 13422; that reference to a definition neither reinstates EO 13422 nor continues its commands, and no instrument reinstating EO 13422 is held. Other held orders that name EO 12866, the order this one amends, are EO 12875 (1993-10-26), EO 13083 and EO 13084 (1998-05-14), EO 13132 (1999-08-04) and EO 13175 (2000-11-06). They act on or cite the parent and all precede this order's signing in 2007; a by-number search of the held order texts for EO 13422 returns only EO 13497 and EO 14219, so none of them names this order or affects its commands.

savings.reason: EO 13497 directs in its section 2 that implementing orders, rules, regulations, guidelines and policies be promptly rescinded to the extent consistent with law, and its section 3 creates no rights. It preserves nothing under EO 13422, and no continuing independent command is shown in the held texts.
